blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Enjoy Highly Absorbable Ionic Magnesium Citrate + Magnesium Glycinate!¹
MAXCALM® - The Next Level of Calm

Life comes at you fast. You've got a life to live and sometimes, stress happens. MAXCALM® helps you move through it all with ease. Our advanced duo of Magnesium Citrate + Magnesium Glycinate helps replenish magnesium, which is important because occasional stress is correlated with low magnesium levels. Now, you can sit back and relax, move smoother, and find balance from within. Mix, sip, and go - MAXCALM® made better.
¹Magnesium citrate and magnesium glycinate are better absorbed than magnesium oxide
^Created from citric acid and magnesium carbonate

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Scoop. Fizz. Sip. For fastest prep, pour approximately 2 teaspoons (4 g) of powder into your favorite glass or mug, add 2-3 oz of hot water, and let it do its fizzy thing. Stir until dissolved, then top off with warm or cold water. Prefer it quick? Just add MAXCALM® to a bottle of cold water and shake it up on the go.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Natural vitality MAXCALM® is a highly absorbable proprietary formulation of ph-balanced magnesium citrate (created from citric acid and magnesium carbonate) and magnesium glycinate in ionic form.
Free of gluten, sugar, artificial color.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children.

For adults only. Consult your doctor before using this product if you are pregnant, lactating, if you have any medical condition, including kidney disease, or if you are currently on medication. May cause gastrointestinal discomfort. Discontinue use if any adverse reactions occur.
Tamper Evident: Do not use if safety seal is broken or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.
Household measure indicated in directions is an approximation. It is advised to weigh the household measure before use to obtain a more precise serving size.
Amount of product in bottle is based on weight. Some settling may occur.
